name: The Ritz-Carlton, Lake Tahoe
positioning: Mountain resort with ski-in/ski-out access to Northstar and a gondola to Northstar Village
best_for: Skiers who want to step from the room onto the mountain
Families, with a children's program and a pool for all ages

facts.text: The Highlands Gondola connects the hotel with Northstar Village.
The gondola is complimentary, runs year-round and needs no reservation.
Rooms have gas fireplaces, contemporary mountain decor and floor-to-ceiling windows.
Suites and Residences offer up to four bedrooms and living spaces such as kitchens and dining areas.
Manzanita is the hotel's slopeside signature restaurant, serving modern American cuisine with a regional mountain influence.
The hotel has Topgolf Swing Suites with private simulators.
Ritz Kids is a children's program with locally inspired environmental and cultural experiences.
The Club Lounge offers complimentary food and beverage presentations five times each day.
The Ritz-Carlton Spa has fireplace-warmed relaxation areas, a dry-heat lodge and a eucalyptus steam room.

highlights.text: The hotel offers ski-in/ski-out access to Northstar.
Guests can dine in a Veuve Clicquot Cabana Chalet at The Backyard.
The hotel offers private mountainside firepits that guests can reserve for roasting marshmallows and making s'mores.
Resort guests have access to the Lake Club, with lakefront amenities including an outdoor whirlpool, fireplaces, beach access and a private pier.

considerations.text: Club Lounge access requires an upgraded booking.
WhataHotel notes the remote mountain location calls for advance planning for access.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting the luxury positioning.
